findings.issue: Task 7 modifies 6 production files (ProjectService, ProjectController, BotService, BotController, ProfileService, ProfileController) plus ~13 test files = ~19 files total. This is well above the 1-3 files atomicity heuristic. The task is justified by the explicit cross-module `requireOwned(...)` coupling (ProjectService is consumed by BotService.connect/etc) and by the Wave 2 atomic-flip per D5/D9. Splitting it further would require temporary Mono-wrapping shims that deliver zero value (and cannot exist since WebFlux symbols leave the classpath in the same commit). The aggregation is the lesser evil but it stretches the atomicity rule.
findings.fix: Acceptable as-is given D5/D9 atomic-flip rationale documented in tech-spec. If a future split is desired (e.g. profile/ vs project+bot/), it would require a coordination doc but is not blocking. No change required for this batch.
